messages:
sara_support: FYI a customer reported being charged twice for the same session. They say request retried after a timeout and now invoice shows doubled tokens. attaching their csv and invoice id I-90432.

mike_eng: can you drop the request ids / trace ids they saw and an example times? we can check ingress logs and our retry behavior.

sara_support: customer provided timeline: 2026-03-14T15:22:10Z initial request, got 502 after 1.2s, their client retried and then got 200 at 15:22:12Z. trace IDs: trace=tr-7a9c, rpc=rpc-88f. invoice I-90432 shows 2x token lines for same session id. csv attached. :frowning:

mike_eng: grabbing logs now. quick note: our gateway currently retries once on 5xx if no idempotency-key present. that can create duplicate ingestion entries if downstream ack is lost.

jess_billing: I-90432 in billing ledger shows two meter events: 
- meter_event 2026-03-14T15:22:12Z tokens=324 session=ses-4432
- meter_event 2026-03-14T15:22:13Z tokens=324 session=ses-4432
Dashboard (prod-usage) shows only one ingestion at 15:22:12Z though. ledger/counts vs metrics mismatch.

mike_eng: found gateway log for trace tr-7a9c: ```
[2026-03-14T15:22:10.123Z] gateway: received req id=req-17234 session=ses-4432
[2026-03-14T15:22:11.330Z] gateway: upstream=runtime returned 502, routing to retry (no Idempotency-Key)
[2026-03-14T15:22:12.004Z] gateway: dispatched retry req id=req-17234-retry session=ses-4432
[2026-03-14T15:22:12.120Z] runtime: response 200 tokens=324 ledger_event=le-9981
[2026-03-14T15:22:12.125Z] ledger: wrote event le-9981 tokens=324
[2026-03-14T15:22:13.130Z] ledger: wrote event le-9982 tokens=324 (duplicate from retry)
```
Shows runtime forwarded both attempts to ledger; apparently ledger accepted both (le-9981 and le-9982).

sara_support: customer also shared their request headers for the call: ```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer tok_xxx
Content-Type: application/json
User-Agent: my-sdk/1.2.0
# no Idempotency-Key header present
```
They say mobile SDK didn't set idempotency by default.

jess_billing: ledger writes explain the invoice. dashboard sampling is tied to aggregated counters which dedup on our request_id dimension, but ledger is append-only. if ledger accepted both writes, invoice will include both.

mike_eng: root cause: client retried after gateway 502, gateway replayed request because we allow a single automatic retry when Idempotency-Key absent. replay got through and ledger didn't enforce dedupe at write-time.

mike_eng: proposed immediate actions:
- short-term (hotfix): have gateway stop automatic retry on 5xx for requests without Idempotency-Key (reject with 503 + hint)
- short-mid: add ledger-level idempotency by checking request fingerprint (session + payload hash + optional idempotency key) and drop duplicates within 60s window
- notify customer and offer invoice adjustment if we confirm duplicates

jess_billing: agree. I can draft a refund/credit if engineering confirms both ledger events map to same user session and same tokens. please tag me when you have the ledger event correlation.

mike_eng: to help repro we can run this script against staging (it simulates a 502 then a replay):
```bash
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.run/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer test" -d '{"prompt":"x"}' -v --trace-ascii - 
# then simulate client retry immediately without idempotency header
```
expected: two ledger events currently. after hotfix gateway should respond with 503 and not replay.

replay-bot: deploy plan created: hotfix/gateway-no-auto-retry (PR #2911) scheduled for 2026-03-15T02:00 UTC, rolling restart of gateway cluster.

dave_cust: thanks for the fast triage. our finance team is asking for an ETA on a credit.

jess_billing: I will hold off issuing anything until eng confirms duplicate event ids (le-9981/le-9982) map to same invoice line. if confirmed, we'll issue a credit and reverse the duplicate ledger event.

mike_eng: confirmed: le-9981 and le-9982 same session, payload hash equal. will add dedupe check and then work with billing to reverse one write.

sara_support: passing to customer: "Thanks — they want the credit and want SDK guidance. any short client workaround we can give them now?"

mike_eng: workaround for customers: include an Idempotency-Key header per user action (uuid) and set SDK to reuse key across retries. also increase client-side retry backoff and detect 5xx vs network timeouts (don't auto-retry on 5xx unless idempotency provided).

jess_billing: I'll queue the manual credit once eng confirms ledger reversal steps. will post update here. :+1:

sara_support: thanks team :heart:
